subject: Discovery recap — proposed ML/infra deep dive (60-90 min)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Anna Chen <anna@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — proposed ML/infra deep dive (60-90 min)

Anna — thanks for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step so we can get your ML and infra teams into a technical deep dive: 

Recap (high level)
- BrightLayer is focused on reducing per-token inference costs for synchronous customer-facing features and improving 95th percentile tail latency for sub-150 token responses.
- Main constraints: VPC-only deployment for production, strict key management (HSM/KMS), and a compliance window for audit logs.
- Primary success metric: stable p95 < 220ms at 10 req/s with Golden prompt set; secondary: 30% cost reduction vs current hosted endpoint.

Proposed next step
- Schedule a 60–90 minute Technical Deep Dive (ML + Infra) to cover: model selection & quantization tradeoffs, network/VPC connectivity, prefix caching & batching profile, and rollout/fallback policies.
- Suggested agenda (attached, also pasted below).
- Candidate slots (PT): Tue 2027-05-17 10:00–11:30, Wed 2027-05-18 09:00–10:30, Thu 2027-05-19 13:00–14:30. Tell us which works and who from your side will attend (network/security engineer + ML infra lead recommended).

Draft agenda (attached as redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.docx):
1) 10 min — Introductions & goals
2) 20 min — Workload shape and SLAs (BrightLayer) — expected request distribution and prompts
3) 25 min — Redwood serving runtime: batching, KV/prefix caching, quantization profile options
4) 20 min — Networking & security checklist (VPC peering, egress, KMS/HSM, audit logs)
5) 10–15 min — Rollout plan & next steps (canary, fallbacks, metrics)

I've attached a one-pager (brightlayer-tdx-prep.pdf) with items to collect ahead of the call (sample prompts, perf targets, network contacts). If you confirm a slot we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-call checklist for your ops team to fill out.

If any of the proposed slots don't work, tell me two windows that do and we'll coordinate.

Thanks — excited to dig in.

—
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0119

Thanks, Olga — really helpful summary and the agenda looks good. We're keen to run the deep dive with both ML and infra in the room. 

Confirmed slot: Tue 2027-05-17 10:00–11:30 PT works for us. I'll be joined by Samir Rao (ML Platform Lead) and I'm looping in our Ops alias so they can provide network contacts.

Two items for the agenda I'd like to add: 
- 15m to discuss our data residency requirements (we have EU customers and need clarity on regional hosting).
- A quick look at how Redwood handles key rotation and HSM integration — Samir flagged this as a blocker for pilot sign-off.

Please send the calendar invite and the pre-call checklist to ops@brightlayer.com. Also, can you share a short list of what logs and retention options Redwood supports (SOC2 audit context)?

Appreciate it — Anna

--
Anna Chen

anna@brightlayer.com | +1 (650) 555-0248
